notes: «وحدثني» starts a second isnad (rule 4): the first group ends at Ibn Shihab, the second carries the saying through «قال الزهري فأخبرني عروة» and is its own group
the second Zuhri («قال الزهري») is the same man as Ibn Shihab of the first group; they are not merged across groups
Bukhari's saying ends at Aisha; «ابن عباس» in the commentary is not a link
